newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Zhongyi in three-for-10 scrip payout.
newsitem.headline: Zhongyi in three-for-10 scrip payout.

text.p: Changsha Zhongyi Electric Appliance Co Ltd shareholders have approved an interim dividend of three bonus shares for every 10 held, according to a notice in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The deadline to register for the dividend is September 27, Zhongyi said, adding that its class A shares will go ex-dividend on October 3 and the bonus shares will be listed on October 7.

The company, which operates a joint venture with Swedish firm Electrolux AB, reported after-tax profits of 6.18 million yuan for the first half of 1996, down from 7.27 million a year ago, under Chinese accounting standards.
The firm blamed the earnings slide on rising prices for raw materials and on Beijing's credit clampdown.
